name: Ocean Buddy
subtitle: Water Sports Spots & Trips
promotionalText: Explore 280 water sports spots, plan your next trip and keep your favorites and notes together.
description:
Your next trip starts with Ocean Buddy.

Explore 280 spots for surfing, diving, snorkeling, paddleboarding, kayaking and other water sports. Pick an activity, browse regions and discover each destination through photos, practical details and a map for each activity. Information still being verified is clearly marked.

PLAN YOUR TRIP
Create an itinerary, add stops, organize dates and keep your notes in one place. Save your favorites and share a copy of your trip.

TAKE TIME TO EXPLORE
Browse immersive galleries and get to know each spot: activities, skill level guidance, access and things to watch out for. If you like, turn on ambient sound and subtle terrain shading. Weather conditions with timestamps help you prepare when you’re online.

SHARE WITH CARE
When the community is available, read approved tips or sign in with your email to suggest a review, a spot or a selected copy of your trip. Contributions are checked by a person before they become visible. Your notes and other private details are shared only if you select them in the preview.

MEET POULPY
Poulpy joins you as you explore. Use the built-in guide, or enable AI with your consent to ask questions. Its answers may contain errors and do not replace local information.

KEEP YOUR JOURNAL WITH YOU
The catalog and included photos remain available offline. Your favorites, trips and notes are stored on your device. Weather, map tiles, AI and the community require an internet connection.

Ocean Buddy helps you plan an outing. Actual conditions, local guidance and your instructors or guides always take priority. The app does not book services and does not replace required qualifications or a marine navigation or diving tool.
